paper_style.palette_strategy: Figures use role colors rather than a shared quantitative palette: Figure 1 uses yellow/purple/pink route categories over a pale map, Figure 2 uses blue modules plus green query and cyan response arrows, and Figure 3 uses blue/orange method lines. Tables remain black/white and encode priority with bold and partial rules.
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: All three figures are embedded high-resolution raster images (Figure 1 1306×908 at about 594 dpi, Figure 2 4166×1228 at about 765 dpi, Figure 3 4736×1016 at about 870 dpi); table text/rules and captions are PDF vector objects.
paper_style.style_consistency: Caption numbering and book-style table hierarchy are consistent. Figure typography and palettes vary by figure role, while table typography is stable; missing uncertainty definitions and abbreviated method names reduce cross-object self-containment.

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: Trajectory segments that strongly reflect user-specific behaviors pose higher privacy risks than those that resemble common or overlapping ones.

color.semantic_mapping: 黄色线路表示 User 1，紫色线路表示 other users，半透明粉色带表示 sensitive segments；浅灰地图和深灰地标为背景语义，蓝/橙/绿圆环表示不同端点。

encodings.x: 无坐标比例尺的空间位置/经度概念
encodings.y: 无坐标比例尺的空间位置/纬度概念
encodings.shape: 路线节点、端点圆环与地标图标
encodings.line: 黄色和紫色轨迹，粉色敏感带叠加
encodings.text: 图内 legend 与 User 1 trajectories、Other user trajectories、Sensitive segments 标签

figures.data_and_statistics: 这是概念性城市地图，没有样本数、坐标单位、地理范围、聚合方式、分母或误差；线路与端点只表达风险直觉，不能作为定量地理测量。
figures.evidence_relation: p.2 的行为特异性/隐私风险主张 → Figure 1 → §3.1 trajectory sensitivity module → 由 discriminator 输出驱动的 per-sample privacy budget；该图承担方法动机，不承担 utility 或 MIA 实证。
design_strengths: 三类轨迹和敏感带的空间叠加可直接传达风险直觉。
legend、路径颜色和端点形状共同建立编码入口。
作为引言窄幅图，能把抽象 sensitivity 概念连接到 mobility 场景。
design_weaknesses: 没有比例尺、北向、真实地理来源或采样说明。

黄色、粉色与浅灰在灰度或低对比显示中区分度有限，图内小字号受版面限制。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用一张空间叠加图压缩“个体特异性 → 隐私风险 → 自适应保护”的机制链；caption 应明确 conceptual illustration，避免示意路线被当作测量结果。

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 motivates heterogeneous sensitivity, Figure 2 defines the federated data/reward boundary, Tables 1–3 compare baseline and matched-noise utility, Tables 4–5 and 8–9 cover white-box/LiRA MIA, Table 6 ablates λGP, Table 7 compares LDP with central training, Table 10 tests user participation, and Figure 3 summarizes best-over-λGP trends.
cross_object_system.caption_system: Captions start with Figure/Table number and generally state setup and comparison. Figure 2 is title-only; Tables 4/5/8/9 report member split only for some attack settings and never define ±; Figure 3 caption says λGP includes 0 while the surrounding text says 1.
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Tables group methods and protocol variables through one- or two-level headers: noise groups in Tables 2/3/6/7/10, attack method/metric groups in Tables 4/5/8/9, and LDP/Central or user-percentage groups in Tables 7/10. Method abbreviations PG and PATEGAIL++ variants require prose expansion.
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 2 and Eqs. (4)–(9) define local discriminators, adaptive Laplace aggregation, LDP and WGAN-GP; Tables 1–5/7 report utility and MIA, Table 6 supplies fixed λGP ablation, Figure 3 takes its best-over-λGP summary, and Table 10 supplies user-subset robustness.
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: Main Tables 4/5 establish Geolife MIA and Appendix Tables 8/9 repeat the threat models on Telecom; main Table 6 feeds Appendix Figure 3; §4.2 defers user-subset results to Appendix Table 10. Core utility/privacy claims remain in the main paper, while cross-dataset and configuration-selection claims depend on the appendix.
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: Table families consistently use Nimbus Roman No9 L with Computer Modern math and approximately 8.5/9.5 pt body/header sizes. Figure 1/2 use serif labels, Figure 3 uses small sans-serif raster labels; the figure switch is role-driven but creates a small-size readability gap.
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Color is local to figures and semantic rather than globally quantitative: route roles in Figure 1, computation/communication roles in Figure 2, and methods in Figure 3. Tables are grayscale, so cross-object comparison depends on labels, bold, and rules rather than color.

most_reusable_patterns: 用空间叠加图把个体特异性、隐私风险和保护机制动机连接起来。
用带数据驻留、信号类型、聚合公式和反馈回路的 pipeline 图定义 federated trust boundary。
用固定协议下的多级表头和 small multiples 分别呈现 noise × method × metric 的 utility/ablation 结构。
对跨 dataset 的攻击实验复用同一表头，降低 threat-model 复核成本。
highest_value_objects: Figure 2：方法边界与 reward aggregation 总览。
Table 2：Geolife matched-noise utility 的正文核心对照。
Table 4：Geolife white-box MIA 的主隐私证据。
Table 6：固定 λGP 配置的可复核消融。
failure_patterns: Figure 3 对 λGP 做 best-over-configuration 后选择，且 caption/正文出现 0/1 候选冲突。
Tables 4/5/8/9 的 ± 没有统计定义、重复次数或随机基线。
Table 10 的 PG 缩写未展开，宽表字号小且没有变化高亮。
Table 1 把 centralized/non-DP baselines 与 federated/DP 方法共表，严格可比性依赖正文 caveat。
主文将 utility、privacy、成本/规模分散到不同对象，未形成同一决策面。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文采用“概念风险地图 → 联邦方法管线 → 分组 utility/MIA 表 → λGP、LDP 与用户参与率扩展”的视觉策略，以紧凑版面传达 sensitivity-aware private trajectory generation 的机制和证据边界。
